body: Default values update on every change? 🤔 Isn't there a more efficient way?

Oh, that's cool! I really need to take a look at what's new in core, my knowledge on that might be a bit dated.
Anyway, I took the opportunity and replaced all other places where this can be used in that file (~15).

This method is already pretty cheap, so I don't think it's worth it.
I guess you can reduce the calls, but it's not that straight-forward. There is not really a better place to call this. (We _could_ make get_input_port_default_value a virtual method and override that, but I'd rather not...)
The only other thing I'm thinking about is a separate signal for changes to the group interface (=ports) since that could be useful for other stuff as well. But that's for another PR, especially since this line was just an incidental rename because the old name was misleading.
